data.narrative:
Radical AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $55M to date. The target operates within a competitive landscape of 9 private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public comparable, though the narrow peer set limits direct market-based triangulation.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology provides the primary valuation anchor. Applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression to the $55M raised yields an implied valuation of $138M. This method is applicable because it reflects observed financing step-ups within the early-stage deep-tech investing cycle. Peer-median comparison was not executable; while 11 robotics and manufacturing peers exist in the broader universe, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies yielded insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3) to support a reliable median anchor.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $117M to $158M, centered on $138M. The median estimate carries moderate confidence given its foundation on a single methodological pillar. Key uncertainties include the limited peer dataset for market-based validation, the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier to Radical AI's specific risk profile, and stage-progression sensitivity to macro financing conditions. Management pedigree (Army Research Lab background, UC Berkeley faculty) and prior capital efficiency merit qualitative weight but do not alter quantitative results.
